name: Reading Time Estimator
summary: Estimate how long text takes to read or speak — adjustable words-per-minute, plus word and sentence counts.
description: Paste an article or draft to estimate silent reading time and speaking time. Tune reading and speaking WPM, and see words, sentences, paragraphs, and characters. Everything stays in your browser.

faqs.question: What WPM does it use?
faqs.answer: Defaults are 200 words per minute for reading and 150 for speaking. Drag the sliders to match your audience.

faqs.question: How is time rounded?
faqs.answer: Non-empty text rounds up to at least one minute for display, matching common blog “read time” conventions.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Estimation runs entirely in your browser.
